name: one_body_of_two_is_not_the_part
why: Z-C21.10, finding N61. check_body_geometry with «body_uid» filters the bodies of GetBodies2 down to the one asked for, and then judged what was left: one body, so «A single solid body, closed and free of defects: as geometry it can be exported.» That sentence is about the PART, and on a part of two bodies it is false: an STL of it is two separate shells (see `two_bodies_do_not_export`). IPartDoc~GetBodies2.html: «false gets all of the bodies in the part» -- the count was there before the filter, and the verdict did not use it.
defect_caught: Step 3 asks for ONE body of a part of TWO. The verdict must speak for that body and say how many the part has: «verdict» names the body, says «only» and «the part has 2 bodies», and does not say «A single body»; «bodies_in_part» is 2 and «verdict_about» names the body. On library 0.140.0 the first expectation of step 3 is RED: the sentence is «A single solid body, closed and free of defects: as geometry it can be exported.». Step 4 is the same part without «body_uid»: the verdict on the part, unchanged.
_the_numbers: Block 100 x 100 x 20 = 200000 mm3. move_bodies copies it 600 mm along z: 2 bodies, 400000 mm3 (as in `two_bodies_do_not_export`). bodies_in_part = 2 with or without «body_uid»; bodies_total = 1 with it (the bodies looked at), 2 without.

does_not_include: as geometry it can be exported
expect.why: THE LINE THAT IS RED ON 0.140.0, and it comes first so that the old library stops here with a red and not with «missing field» on the new fields below. The body is sound, and the sentence must not let that stand for the part.
every body of the part, whatever «body_uid» asked
which body the verdict speaks for. The number of the body is not asked: it changes between runs (Z-C16), and the body is named by name in the arguments
the bodies looked at: one, the one asked for
on the body asked for the question is «is it sound», and it is: the verdict is limited to the body, not turned into a no
the same part, asked as a whole: two bodies, not printable -- the verdict of `two_bodies_do_not_export`, untouched by the fix
